name: TimeBomb AnkleBreak!
desc:
Welcome to TimeBomb AnkleBreak!
You have 15 seconds to pass the bomb to someone else before it explodes.

⚠️ Cheating in the game will get your account banned !

How to Play:

💣 Hold the Bomb: the clock is ticking! Touch another player to pass the bomb.

Features:

🎵 SFX: Lots of different sounds

I will be adding way more sounds in the future!
